preprocessing_decisions.age_sentinel_meaning: ages above 89, per the v1.0.2 changelog
preprocessing_decisions.excluded_reason: 68%/57% missing; physiologically impossible values (min height 6cm, min weight 5kg)
preprocessing_decisions.lr_feature_scaling: StandardScaler fit on folds 1-8 and applied to continuous columns only (age_imputed, recording_year); sex, age_censored, and every one-hot device/site/nurse indicator pass through unscaled on their raw 0/1 scale (a judgment call: standardizing sparse dummy columns would inflate rare categories' coefficients by the inverse of their own tiny within-column standard deviation, which is an interpretability artifact, not signal)
preprocessing_decisions.label_convention: all scp_codes keys mapped via diagnostic==1, no likelihood threshold (same primary convention as the v0.1.x audit)

coefficients_model: B5_all, LogisticRegression, seed=42, standardized feature scale
